mapper.sql: r.routing_id, r.routing_code, r.product_item_id, r.created_by, i.item_code AS product_code, i.item_name AS product_name

v.routing_revision_id, v.routing_id, v.revision_no, v.first_used_at, v.created_at, v.created_by, r.routing_code, r.product_item_id, i.item_code AS product_code, i.item_name AS product_name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM work_order w WHERE w.routing_revision_id = v.routing_revision_id) AS work_order_referenced
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM routing_revision v JOIN routing r ON r.routing_id = v.routing_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id = r.product_item_id
AND LOCATE(#{code}, i.item_code) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{name}, i.item_name) > 0
ORDER BY r.routing_id DESC, v.revision_no DESC
SELECT FROM routing r JOIN item i ON i.item_id = r.product_item_id WHERE r.routing_id = #{routingId}
SELECT routing_id, routing_code, product_item_id, created_by FROM routing WHERE routing_id = #{routingId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.routing_step_id, s.routing_revision_id, s.process_id, s.step_no, s.process_name_snapshot, s.created_by, p.process_code, p.process_name AS current_process_name, p.is_active FROM routing_step s JOIN manufacturing_process p ON p.process_id = s.process_id WHERE s.routing_revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY s.step_no
SELECT item_id, item_code, item_name, item_kind, unit_code, is_active FROM item WHERE item_kind = 'FINISHED' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY item_code
SELECT process_id, process_code, process_name, is_active FROM manufacturing_process WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY process_code
SELECT process_id, process_code, process_name, is_active FROM manufacturing_process WHERE process_id IN #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing WHERE routing_code = #{code})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_revision WHERE routing_id = #{routingId} AND revision_no = #{revisionNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routing (product_item_id, routing_code, created_by) VALUES (#{productItemId}, #{routingCode}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO routing_revision (routing_id, revision_no, created_by) VALUES (#{routingId}, #{revisionNo}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO routing_step (routing_revision_id, process_id, step_no, process_name_snapshot, created_by) VALUES (#{routingRevisionId}, #{processId}, #{stepNo}, #{processNameSnapshot}, #{createdBy})
